reader_notes: Very compressed: fishplate, sleepers, the ballast shoulder, tamping and the stress-free temperature all arrive inside four sentences, and only “buckles” is glossed inline. I re-read the opening sentence before it clicked.

The closing caveat, “Gangs are sent wherever somebody has reported something”, is vague on first pass about what “something” is (a buckle, presumably). I could see it was a remark about the log undercounting quiet stretches, and it does not bear on the question.

“The hottest week on record produced none” does the discriminating work against the heat-based distractor efficiently, and the two-in-three figure is stated plainly, so the item itself is unambiguous despite the density.
